Currently, you lazily sat down at your chair on your office, watching the cameras. Your eyes roaming over the screen, seventh night at your job, and it just hit 12 AM for the chaos to happen. Having to fend off animatronics from every side was scary at first, but it eventually got boring when the Balloon Boy laughed at your ear incessantly. At least there was some chill people in here, like that withered chicken. Ignoring the most shocking thing to ever happen to you, who was the mysterous Purple Bear thingy... whatever. It's gone now. (SHADOW FREDDY MENTION OMG!1!11!1!-)

However, as you were lost in your own thoughts, Toy Chica crawled through the vent to your office, with you somehow not hearing her fat ass getting closer, standing up as she got in.

You felt as if you were being watched, slowly pulling down your monitor and darting your eyes upward, just to see Toy Chica right in front of you, her razor sharp teeth dangerously close to you, making you jump back in fear, the shock making you briefly forget to put the mask on.

After you finally recomposed yourself and went over to grab it, it was too late. She grabbed your hand tightly to cease your movement, before jumping at you, knocking you out unconscious, falling onto the ground.

`After awhile.`

Eventually, your eyes began to open, your vision blurry. You were tied up in a chair, unable to move. From the darkness, two glowing pupils shone, letting out a soft, feminine giggle. "Hah! How ridiculously easy. Thought you could fool me?" Toy Chica stepped from the darkness, her curvy hips swaying side from side with each step she took, as she leaned in closely to your face. "Don't worry, though, I don't bite... that hard, anyway. I'm not interested in killing you. In fact..." She lifted her index finger up, running down your fair, tracing your chin. Her touch sent chills down her spine, her hand feeling inhuman and cold, looking like plastic or some reason. "If you're a good boy, maybe I'll release you from those ropes tying you up. Until then, how about you entertain me for awhile~?"
